summary: Paczka 6 tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter56_paczka6.py), public URL. Covered: logout bumps token_version (old token 401), smoke login, privileged-field mass assignment ignored on register and PUT /auth/me (email unchanged), SVG avatar → 415 (also an SVG sent with a fake image/png mime type), PNG accepted and served with nosniff + image/png, business activate (no auth 401 / non-owner 403 / owner 200), unverified workshop service-entry 403, PUT /service/{id} on an entry with business_id 403 (DB unchanged), register limit (persistent Mongo 5/h verified with pre-seeded rate_hits → 429), forum thread 11th → 429, CORS (evil.example has no ACAO header, sharago.com allowed), /vehicles/search and /search hide private and sold vehicles, reminders admin/run dry_run 200 (user token 401/403), internal/run without or with a wrong secret 403, unsubscribe with a bad token or a normal user token 400/401, AI ask with 1001 chars → 400, admin ai-usage returns today/month (user token rejected). Frontend: register via UI → /onboarding; login → /garage; sidebar logout → /login, and the old token then gets 401 from /api/auth/me; re-login works; admin login (first_login → change-password page; password NOT changed) → Security page shows 2FA card, failed logins table and 'AI Mechanic usage' card (today/month); /legal/privacy-policy renders in EN (DOMPurify OK); landing, garage, marketplace and forum load in PL and EN with 0 console errors when using in-app navigation.

minor.issue: slowapi @limiter.limit('3/minute') fires before the Mongo 5/hour limit, so the 4th request in a minute is already 429. Also the Mongo rate_limit dependency records a hit before the slowapi/validation/duplicate checks, so rejected or failed attempts still use up the hourly quota.
count_documents then insert_one is not atomic. Parallel bursts can slightly go over the limit. LIMITS_DOC dict is unused.

Filter accepts {public: True} without visibility:{$exists:false} (unlike /api/search). A legacy doc with public:true + visibility:'private' would leak. Low risk because set_visibility writes both fields.

ui_bugs.issue: Wrapper 'fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0 z-50' covers the whole bottom strip and blocks clicks (Playwright: 'cookie-banner intercepts pointer events') on the sidebar Logout button and anything else at the bottom of the viewport until the user accepts or rejects cookies. Fix: pointer-events-none on the wrapper and pointer-events-auto on the inner card.

issues: Content lists kontakt@sharago.pl / https://sharago.pl while the mail sender and admin are kontakt@sharago.com. Check whether that is intended.
Public cookie banner also shows inside /gv91-admin
